title: Implement blocked GF(p) triangular solve (026fc832 Phase 6)
description:
Phase 6 implementation task under epic `026fc832`. Implements blocked GF(p) triangular solve building on the panelized PLE implementation. No separate design — uses standard blocked back-substitution algorithm (Higham § 14.1).

Parent epic: `026fc832`. Predecessor: panelized PLE implementation (sibling).

## Amendment (2026-05-27, user-approved, session 11)

R0 evidence (`dev/bench_results/2026-05-26-6613abf4-blocked-solve.md`) closed 7 of 13 A8 solve cells PASS (rows 47-50, 57, 58, 75). The remaining 6 cells are routed per user-approved decision (session 11 AskUserQuestion: "Investigate GF(251)/n=64 borderline first; amend the rest"):

- **Rows 53, 54** (GF(251)/n=256 uniform + deficient @ 2.331× / 2.400×): `[aspirational]` inheriting the `6823c8a0` GF(251)/n=256 PLE-side gap. The blocked solve's TRSM updates inherit the PLE bottleneck at this cell. Closure requires the blocked Schur-update kernel or float-cascade PLE work tracked under 6823c8a0's existing [aspirational] amendment.
- **Rows 51, 52** (GF(251)/n=64 uniform + deficient @ 1.674× / 1.728×): deferred to follow-up task `d36cc414` (GF(251)/n=64 borderline investigation).
- **Rows 55, 56** (GF(65521)/n=64 uniform + deficient @ 2.095× / 1.833×): deferred to follow-up task `9138d86c` (GF(65521)/n=64 blocked solve kernel).

## Background

Closes A8 rows 47-58, 75 (solve cells over GF(7/251/65521) and GF(31)).

- [hard] Production code implementing blocked triangular solve calling into the panelized PLE + `fp_small_try_gemm_classical`.
- [hard] Bit-exact correctness vs the existing scalar solve on a proptest sweep across GF(7), GF(31), GF(127), GF(241), GF(251), GF(65521) at boundary lengths plus rank-deficient regimes.
- [hard] 5-trial CCX1-pinned benchmarks at n in {64, 256, 1024} per prime per regime.
- [hard] [AMENDED 2026-05-27 — see Amendment block above] Every A8 solve cell (rows 47-58, 75) either PASSes (ratio ≤ 1.5× vs fflas) OR carries an explicit user-approved [aspirational] amendment OR is closed by a named follow-up task. Rows 53, 54 are [aspirational] at 2.331× / 2.400× inheriting 6823c8a0's GF(251)/n=256 PLE-side gap. Rows 51, 52 are deferred to `d36cc414`. Rows 55, 56 are deferred to `9138d86c`.
- [hard] No regression on currently-PASSing cells (delta ≤ 5%).
- [hard] No `unsafe` outside kernel crates.
- [hard] Brief design rationale in the impl task's evidence doc explaining the blocking strategy (no separate design task because the algorithm is standard).
